turns.query: For USD, EUR and JPY, map each denomination to the United States, euro area and Japan respectively. Compare the BIS broad real effective exchange-rate index (2020=100) at 2019-Q1 end with 2025-Q4 end and select the currency with the largest absolute percentage change, breaking an exact tie by three-letter currency code ascending. Report the screened count, selected exact uppercase three-letter currency token and its BIS reference-area label verbatim, including the two-letter prefix before the colon, followed by its two EER levels and signed change. For that currency, also report total credit to EME non-bank borrowers in 2019-Q1 and 2025-Q4 in the currency's reported millions and the signed percentage change. Carry the selected denomination forward and interpret the relationship and material limits of the two paths.

For the carried currency, use quarterly BIS international debt securities and bank loans/deposits to EME non-bank borrowers from 2000-Q1 through 2022-Q4. Estimate the Engle-Granger log-level relation with debt securities as the dependent variable and an intercept. Apply a residual ADF regression with an intercept and no augmentation lags, using -3.37 as the fixed rejection boundary. Report the sample boundaries/count, long-run intercept and slope, residual sample standard deviation, residual ADF level coefficient and t statistic, and whether the unit-root null is rejected. Across the full carried credit panel, also report the maximum absolute residual of total credit minus those two components. Carry the diagnostic decision and fitted state forward, and interpret the distinct roles of the residual unit-root diagnostic and the component reconciliation in choosing and describing the next model.

Use the carried test decision to select the training-sample dynamic model. If the residual unit-root null was rejected, estimate an intercept-bearing error-correction regression of debt-security log change on the lagged long-run residual and contemporaneous loan/deposit log change. Otherwise estimate an intercept-bearing first-difference ARDL with one lag of debt-security log change plus contemporaneous and one-quarter-lagged loan/deposit log changes. Report the selected model using the exact canonical branch token defined by its output contract, followed by effective observation count, intercept, branch-specific lag-state coefficient, current and lagged loan-change coefficients, R-squared and maximum absolute unscaled OLS normal-equation moment max|X' residual|. For the error-correction branch, report the structurally absent lagged loan-change coefficient as zero. Carry the fitted coefficients forward and interpret the economic status and limitations of the selected dynamic relation.

Hold the carried coefficients fixed and produce rolling ex-post conditional predictions for 2023-Q1 through 2025-Q4 using the realized model regressors, including the contemporaneous loan/deposit change, for each evaluated quarter. Compare their fitted changes with a zero-change debt-security benchmark. Report the evaluation boundaries/count, both RMSEs in log points and whether the dynamic conditional prediction is lower. Identify the quarter with the largest absolute conditional-prediction error, breaking an exact tie by earlier quarter, and report its signed error as actual minus predicted debt-security log change. Also report the selected area's broad real-EER change from the prior quarter's final month to that quarter's final month. Interpret the conditional comparison, currency overlay and material information-set/sample limits.
